name: Radio
accessibility: Options share one native group so only one can ever be checked, and arrow keys move both focus and selection between them.
Every option shows a visible focus ring as keyboard focus moves through the group.

source.notes: Rendered snapshot of the selected type/configuration, with State and Appearance and Size captured as crossed properties (State, Appearance, Size) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant. Label, Required, Supporting text, Show supporting text, Error message, Show error are bound Text/Boolean properties (Supporting text/Error message are mutually exclusive in the live render, so each was harvested and bound separately rather than sharing one node). Label Placement stays a page-level choice. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit. Interaction rules and unseen configurations require authored behavior bindings.
